about: How tools/pack.py builds Whispers of the Old Gods 2016 (docs/packs/format.md, 'Build recipes'): on The League of Explorers (base), so on The Grand Tournament, Blackrock Mountain, Goblins vs Gnomes, Naxxramas and Classic: their cards, patches, scripts, fonts, texts and pictures by reference, without Classic's hand-tuned text layout (skip); then the 134 cards of Whispers of the Old Gods and their 31 tokens as the release build 12574 has them (patch 5.0.0.12574 of 2016-04-24, two days before the release; data/og_cards.json, tools/extract_cards.py --set og) with the names and texts of that build for every card of the chain (cards.texts.json, written by the same tool), and this pack's own patch (cards.patch.json: the scripts of scripts/og.lua, the keywords, the older cards that changed by then).
